events.title: Cabinet — Capex Support Scheme for Critical Mineral Processing (₹2,814 Cr, lithium & nickel)
events.summary: On 4 Nov 2026 the Union Cabinet chaired by PM Modi approved the ‘Capex Support Scheme to Promote Critical Mineral Processing’: ₹2,814 Cr over FY2026-27 to FY2030-31. 30% capital subsidy on eligible investment for FOUR plants only — 2 lithium processing plants (min 30 kt each, support capped at ₹500 Cr per beneficiary) and 2 nickel processing plants (min 50 kt each, capped at ₹900 Cr). Converts lithium/nickel ores & intermediates into high-purity compounds; cobalt recovered as a nickel by-product. End-uses: EVs, BESS, electronics, defence, speciality steel. Selection: technical qualification, then financial bidding — 2 winners per mineral on lowest capex support sought; paid in 3 milestone-linked tranches. No company has been selected; any listed-stock benefit depends on winning a bid. Not stated: eligibility details beyond capacity minimums, local-content rules, application timeline. Related: critical-mineral parks — Odisha (nickel), Maharashtra (lithium).
packages: 2 × lithium plants (≥30 kt, cap ₹500 Cr each)
2 × nickel plants (≥50 kt, cap ₹900 Cr each)

events.title: Cabinet — VISTAR: statistical system overhaul (₹4,371 Cr, MoSPI)
events.summary: On 4 Nov 2026 the Union Cabinet approved ‘Viksit Bharat Initiative for Statistical Transformation, Analytics & Research (VISTAR)’, a central sector scheme of ₹4,371.10 Cr for FY2026-27 to FY2030-31 covering all MoSPI statistical and data-management work. Three components: (1) Comprehensive Statistical Operations & Strengthening of Ecosystem — 59 surveys in the 16th FC cycle (vs 43 earlier), end-to-end digitalisation, AI/ML for data processing/validation/analysis, new indices (Headline Index of Services Production, Index of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises), data cataloguing/interoperability/privacy-by-design, alternate data (mobile phone, scanner, e-commerce); (2) Support for Statistical Strengthening (SSS 2.0) — deliverable-linked funds to States/UTs for district- and million-plus-city estimates, State/District GDP, State IIP; (3) 8th Economic Census with States/UTs down to Gram Panchayat/ward level, baseline for a National Statistical Business Register. Not stated: split of outlay by component, IT vendor budget. LISTED BENEFICIARIES: none verified. Known MoSPI IT work is small or unlisted — common data platform for National Accounts went to Bahwan CyberTek (unlisted); Unified Survey Platform tender is ~₹31.5 Cr (bids closed 14 Oct 2026, no award public); 7th Economic Census was run by CSC e-Governance SPV (unlisted). Tracking-only card; no companies added rather than padding with speculative names.
packages: Comprehensive Statistical Operations & Ecosystem (59 surveys, AI/ML, digitalisation)
New indices: Services Production, Unincorporated Sector Enterprises

events.title: Cabinet CMPS — Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme (₹10,000 Cr)
events.summary: On 28 Oct 2026 the Union Cabinet chaired by PM Modi approved the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme (CMPS): ₹10,000 Cr up to FY2039-40 (FY28–FY40: 3 yrs set-up + 10 yrs production support), announced in Budget 2026-27. Aim: lift domestic container capacity ~10x from ~70,000 TEUs to 7.5 lakh TEUs/yr and cut import dependence. Components: Interest Subvention ₹859 Cr (3% p.a. on term loans; greenfield ≥1,00,000 TEU/yr, brownfield ≥25,000 TEU within 3 yrs); Operational Expenditure Assistance ₹8,891 Cr per box sold to global standards (₹49,500/20ft, ₹86,625/40ft, ₹37,125–74,250 per 20ft specialised); Testing & certification ₹150 Cr (e.g. dynamic longitudinal impact testing); Scheme mgmt ₹100 Cr; Major-port land lease at 25% of notified rate. Local content ≥70% till FY2031-32, ≥90% from FY2032-33. Ancillaries named: corner castings, specialised steel, wooden frames/floors, paints. Demand drivers cited: global fleet replacement, Bharat Container Shipping Line, Vadhavan & Galathea Bay ports. Scheme support needs eligibility/approval by an Inter-Ministerial Steering Committee — not an automatic subsidy to any listed company.
packages: Major-port land lease at 25% of notified rate

events.title: DAC AoN — capital acquisitions (~₹2.12 lakh Cr)
events.summary: On 26 Oct 2026 the Defence Acquisition Council (chaired by RM Rajnath Singh) accorded Acceptance of Necessity for capital buys of about ₹2,12,000 Cr across Army, Navy and IAF. ~82% earmarked for Indian industry. AoN is in-principle clearance, not a signed order. Army: HMV, Self-Propelled Tracked Gun (addl. K9 Vajra), GSRS, LMRH, VSHORADS, platform C-UAS, long-range UAS brick, surveillance UAV, Integrated Surveillance & Strike, Long Range Kamikaze Drone. Navy: Active Offboard Decoy System (AODS) + major naval platforms. IAF: helicopters / Special Utility Helicopters, air defence, weapons, Mobile X-Band Doppler Weather Radar.
packages: Long-range UAS / Surveillance UAV / ISSS / Kamikaze drones
